# KIRA RESEARCH
> Market-entry research on Southeast Asia, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Australia and New Zealand, with a source on every figure. Executive summaries are free to read. Available in English, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese.

## About

KIRA Research publishes desk-research reports on markets, sectors, regulation, competitors and entry routes. Each report is planned around a decision, uses public and licensed sources, tags the source of every figure, and is reviewed by our research team before publication. Reports are desk research from dated public sources and KIRA estimates. KIRA Experts transcripts are modelled interviews built on KIRA's earlier face-to-face field interviews; they are labelled as modelled on every page.

- Offices: Ho Chi Minh City, Singapore, Bangkok
- Coverage: Vietnam, Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore, the Philippines, Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, Brunei, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Australia, New Zealand (new reports are added continuously; published reports to date also include Japan and South Korea)
- Languages: English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese (Chinese editions are being added)
- Access: executive summaries are free; full reports are available to subscribers and buyers. Pricing: https://kiraresearch.com/en/pricing
- Library: https://kiraresearch.com/en/library
- Methodology: https://kiraresearch.com/en/methodology

## Market data and facts

Figures are published on sourced pages, each with its year and source: https://kiraresearch.com/en/markets (answers by country and segment) and https://kiraresearch.com/en/data/ (public statistics).

## What We Publish

### Research reports
- Deep reports organised around a decision: whether a market is worth pursuing, how to enter, how to grow
- Format: executive summary (free), full report online, PDF edition
- Browse: https://kiraresearch.com/en/library

### Insights
- Analyst notes, data explainers and sector commentary
- Browse: https://kiraresearch.com/en/insights/

## Methodology

Desk research from public and licensed sources: government statistics, regulators, company filings, trade bodies and news. Every figure carries a source tag; estimates are labelled as estimates, and where sources disagree the report says so. Each report is reviewed by our research team before publication.

Source tagging convention: [Kira estimates] = our analyst estimates; named sources (e.g. "State Bank of Vietnam") = source citations.

Full methodology: https://kiraresearch.com/en/methodology

## Market facts and trade practice

Server-rendered pages of short, sourced answers (every figure shows its year and source) and practitioner views on how trade works in each market and segment. Practitioner views come from KIRA Experts transcripts: modelled interviews built on KIRA's field interviews, never presented as one person's words.
- Market facts by country and segment: https://kiraresearch.com/en/markets
- How the trade works by industry and topic (channels, pricing, margins, buyers, regulation): https://kiraresearch.com/en/trade
- How we work: https://kiraresearch.com/en/methodology

## How to cite

KIRA Research, <report or transcript title>, <year>, kiraresearch.com/<page path>
Example: KIRA Research, Thailand Data Centres Market Report, 2026, kiraresearch.com/en/reports/<slug>
Cite the report, transcript or insight a figure comes from (each answer links to it) rather than the hub page.

## Kira Experts
Kira Experts arranges conversations with operators, executives, specialists and advisers who have first-hand experience of the markets we cover, matched to the client's question. Pricing is agreed per engagement.
Request an expert: https://kiraresearch.com/en/experts/

## Kira Survey
Kira Survey designs and runs customer surveys and in-depth interviews in the local language, built around the decision the client needs to make. Pricing is agreed per study.
Request a survey: https://kiraresearch.com/en/survey/
